correctness.rationale: PASS. Established complete-quadrics Euler characteristic is kappa(n)=n!U_{n+1}/2^n where U0=0,U1=1 and U_m=2U_{m-1}+2U_{m-2}. The proof computes nu_2(U_m)=floor(m/2)+1_{4|m}nu_2(m): odd terms have a unique lowest 2-power in their binomial expansion; for even indices U_{2r}=U_r V_r and V_{2r}=V_r²-2(-2)^r yields exact cases, including cancellation for odd r. Legendre nu_2(n!)=n-s_2(n) gives the announced ceil(n/2)-s_2(n) plus spike nu_2(n+1) if n=3 mod4, and the oddness n=1,2 only. Independent exact integer recurrences check U and kappa through n=400 and the factorial relation. Infinite proof rests on valuation identities, not finite enumeration.
